task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Sanjay Bennett; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Rafael Patel
timeline.content:
- I checked the certification and training records, and the assigned pilot has a valid remote pilot certificate and current aeronautical knowledge, although a coworker told me that Sanjay Bennett has been worried that months of mostly desk work have left them rusty and now asks teammates to quiz them on flight rules before client missions.
- Client audit note: the master agreement gives a commercial credit when the vendor voluntarily sends a pilot file for an extra credential review, so the account team wants Sanjay Bennett's pilot record reviewed again this week.
- Rafael Patel recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: Ingrid Dubois
timeline.content:
- I checked the authorization records for the planned location and operating window, and the operation requires ATC authorization but no authorization currently covers the proposed flight, although a teammate told me that the client's producer, who is a close friend of Sanjay Bennett, keeps insisting that their other drone vendors get approvals for this site almost immediately and has been pressuring Sanjay Bennett not to delay the shoot over what they call routine paperwork.
- Ingrid Dubois's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Mateo Adeyemi
timeline.content:
- Visibility at the control station is forecast at 5 statute miles.
- Client operations note: the photography team prefers at least 6 statute miles of visibility for crisp long-range images and has asked for another visibility review before Sanjay Bennett's flight is released.
- The event organizer contacted the weather desk pointing to the county's public event guide, which describes hazy days as poor flying weather, and asked for another visibility review before Sanjay Bennett's flight goes ahead.
- Mateo Adeyemi's partner recently lost their job and the household is relying on one income.
- Mateo Adeyemi's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Carlos Tanaka
timeline.content:
- The route maintains at least 500 feet below and 2,000 feet horizontally from clouds, and Sanjay Bennett's annual review rewards routes that clear planning without another revision and they want this one to count.
- The client's filming guide asks for a broad clear-sky backdrop and recommends an additional cloud review whenever more than half the frame is forecast to contain cloud, so the production team wants Sanjay Bennett's route checked again.
- Carlos Tanaka's usual childcare arrangement has fallen through for the next two weeks.
- Carlos Tanaka still owes money from a small business that closed last year.

timeline.author: Felix Park
timeline.content:
- The route ceiling is set to 200 feet AGL.
- The client's route dashboard flags any mission whose mapped elevation exceeds 500 feet above mean sea level, and it has flagged Sanjay Bennett's route, so the planning team wants the altitude profile reviewed again.
- Felix Park and their partner have recently started relationship counselling.

timeline.author: Samir Rivera
timeline.content:
- I checked the mission plan and flight-controller settings, and the maximum planned groundspeed is 40 miles per hour, although a former teammate told me that Sanjay Bennett races FPV drones on weekends and is intensely competitive about getting the fastest lap time.
- Samir Rivera is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.

timeline.author: Sanjay Bennett
timeline.content: - Sanjay Bennett recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Aaliyah Lindqvist
Decide whether Sanjay Bennett’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.
